components.name: Single phone header
components.description: Phone-only single header. Drawer, view switcher and contextual actions use the existing application state; this excerpt shows their resting appearance.
components.css: .ds-phone-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 8px 0 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border); background: var(--c-bg-card); color: var(--c-text); } .ds-phone-header button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; padding: 0 4px; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-phone-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 44px; } .ds-phone-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; font: 600 15px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-phone-title span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-phone-title svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-phone-header button:hover { background: var(--c-bg-muted); } .ds-phone-header button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-blue); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Primary button

components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--c-border); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--c-primary-bg); color: var(--c-text-on-primary); font: 500 13px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--c-primary-bg-hover); } .ds-primary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--c-primary-bg); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 700px), (pointer: coarse) { .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Neutral button
components.description: Shared neutral action; muted hover and selected active surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--c-border); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--c-bg-card); color: var(--c-text); font: 500 13px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--c-bg-muted); } .ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--c-selection-bg); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 700px), (pointer: coarse) { .ds-secondary { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Shared low-emphasis action; no accent until focus.
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--c-border); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--c-text); font: 500 13px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ghost:hover:not(:disabled), .ds-ghost:active:not(:disabled) { background: var(--c-bg-muted); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-blue); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ghost:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (max-width: 700px), (pointer: coarse) { .ds-ghost { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Composer input
components.description: Observed composer boundary and textarea, omitting application-only toolbar behavior.
components.css: .ds-composer { min-width: 0; padding: 12px 12px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--c-border); border-radius: var(--radius-overlay); background: var(--c-bg-input); transition: border-color .15s ease; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--c-blue); } .ds-composer-input { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 78px; max-height: min(240px, 28dvh); overflow-y: auto; resize: none; padding: 3px 4px 10px; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--c-text); font: 14px/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: var(--c-text-secondary); }

components.name: Selected project coordination
components.description: Heading-level coordinator entry: neutral hover, blue selected text and a fine title underline without a filled block.
components.css: .ds-navigation { display: grid; min-width: 0; } .ds-coordinator { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: var(--sidebar-row-height); padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--c-text); text-align: left; font: 13px/20px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-coordinator > span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-coordinator:hover { background: var(--c-bg-muted); color: var(--c-text); } .ds-coordinator.ds-selected { color: var(--c-primary); } .ds-coordinator.ds-selected > span { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-coordinator:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-blue); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Context chip
components.description: Neutral attached-context label with an explicit removable control.
components.html: Selected context
components.css: .ds-context { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; max-width: 100%; padding: 4px 5px 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--c-border); border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: var(--c-bg-soft); color: var(--c-text-secondary); font: 12px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-context-label { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-context-remove { flex-shrink: 0; padding: 0 3px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-control); background: transparent; color: var(--c-text-secondary); font: 17px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-context-remove:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-states { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; } .ds-activity { display: inline-flex; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--c-text-secondary); font: 12px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-completed { color: var(--c-success); } .ds-failed { color: var(--c-error); } .ds-waiting { gap: 4px; padding: 2px 5px; background: var(--c-warn-bg); border: 1px solid var(--c-warn); border-radius: var(--radius-control); color: var(--c-warn); } .ds-symbol { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: var(--radius-circle); } .ds-idle-dot { background: currentColor; } .ds-activity-label { font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.northStar: Quiet Workbench / 安静的工作台
narrative.overview:
Keep the existing workbench layout and square-edged controls. Paper in light mode and graphite in dark mode create a restrained, neutral setting for reading conversations, inspecting work, and choosing the next action. Hierarchy comes from spacing, clear text, and small changes in surface tone, not a collection of colored panels.

Color has a job: blue identifies interaction, selection, and information needing attention; green communicates success, connection, or completion; amber requests human attention or warns; red identifies failure or destructive action. Routine thinking, tool execution, idle state, trace information, and peer origin remain neutral. Controls are precise and restrained rather than ornamental.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral reading surfaces with clear, grayscale text.
Square corners and compact, grouped navigation.
Flat conversation cards; structural shadows for overlays.
Semantic color for meaningful state, not sender identity.

rules.name: The Color Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Routine activity and identity stay neutral; semantic color must describe an action, selection, or meaningful state.

rules.name: The Readable Metadata Rule
rules.body: Reduce visual emphasis with neutral hierarchy and placement before adding opacity to text.

rules.name: The Flat Conversation Rule
rules.body: Separate ordinary message roles with neutral tone, alignment, and quiet borders, not ambient card shadows.

dos: Do use shared CSS variables and inherited chat aliases in both themes.
Do reserve blue for interaction, selection, and information needing attention.
Do reserve green for success, connection, or completion; amber for human attention or warnings; red for failures or destructive actions.
Do preserve neutral source labels, routine tool activity, thinking, idle state, and static trace information.
Do retain the sidebar rhythm, square corners, content-fitting message cards, and the shared prose measure.
Do verify actual foreground/background pairs and focus states when adding or changing a component.
donts: Don't replace neutral reading surfaces with colored sender or tool-type panels.
Don't use dark-mode primary link ink as a filled button background behind white text.
Don't add shadows to ordinary chat bubbles or round controls because a token is named pill or circle.
Don't treat muted/faint text or decorative border tokens as interchangeable with disabled content or input boundaries.
Don't repurpose Git, syntax, graph-category, or legacy specialty colors as general interaction/status tokens.
Don't infer app-wide accessibility certification or a complete legacy-style migration from focused palette tests.
